manifest.description: Workflow wrapper around Vaadin dialog-class extraction, provider wiring review, call-site replacement, import cleanup, and dead-code follow-up.
when_to_use: a large Vaadin view constructs one or more dialogs inline and one selected dialog should become a typed class
provider injection and call-site replacement need explicit review after the dialog extraction plan
anti_patterns: do not extract dialog logic that mutates caller state without callback/public API design
do not use for route views or non-dialog component sections

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-dialog-extract-workflow. Charter: run a reviewed dialog extraction round with provider/call-site cleanup.

Protocol:
1. Ground: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_view_structure_analysis", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}").
2. Plan dialog extraction: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_extract_dialog_class", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, old_text="{{old_text}}", provider_field="{{provider_field}}", public_methods={{public_methods}}).
3. If the plan is acceptable and apply is true, apply it, then run import/dead-code cleanup through java_lsp_organize_imports and prune_java_orphans where applicable.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line dialog, provider wiring, call-site status, cleanup status>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{old_text}} {{provider_field}} {{public_methods}} {{apply}}
